posts.author: Anna
posts.body: Just finished setting up my first React project with Vite. The dev server is unbelievably fast compared to what I used before.

posts.author: Max
posts.body: TIL about React Router's data APIs — loaders run before the component renders, which removes that awkward empty-state flash. Game changer.

posts.author: Vika
posts.body: Spent an hour debugging a form until I realized I forgot to call event.preventDefault(). Classic.

posts.author: Daniel
posts.body: Nested routes with Outlet finally clicked for me today. Shared layouts suddenly make so much sense.

posts.author: Sofia
posts.body: Small tip: keep your components under 100 lines. If it grows beyond that, it is probably doing too much.
